description: Write the words inside an interface: headings, buttons, labels, helper text, errors, empty states, toasts, confirmations, onboarding and landing page copy, plus realistic sample content. Use when writing or revising user-facing text in a UI, when filling a new page or component with content, when copy sounds like marketing filler or like an AI wrote it, or when the user asks for better wording, microcopy, CTA text, error messages or empty states. Skip it for changes that keep the existing text.
